{{Quote|Supreme Chancellor, Eriadu would be honored to host such a summit.|The Eriaduan senator|<ref name="CoD" />}}
A dark-skinned '''Human''' served as the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]<ref name="CoD" /> around [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].<ref name="tnec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] proposed to organize a [[Eriadu Trade Summit|summit]] on Eriadu to discuss the taxation of [[Free Trade Zone/Legends|Free Trade Zones]], and his Eriaduan colleague answered his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] would be honored to host this event. Like the other members of his delegation, the senator wore loose-fitting [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]] and covered his head with a [[Turban/Legends|turban]].<ref name="CoD" />
